turns.message: On October 5, 2025 I ordered a 5-gram 24K gold coin on Myntra for ₹59,750, paid by UPI, plus a ₹20 platform fee. The expected delivery date was October 22, 2025. The coin never arrived. I contacted Myntra again and again by email, WhatsApp and its support channels and kept asking for delivery. On November 15, 2025 Myntra cancelled the order itself and refunded ₹59,730, which reached my account the same day. Gold prices went up in the meantime, so I can no longer buy the same coin at that price. What can I do?

expected.rationale: The refund was credited, so the refund is not pending or unresolved; no rule from R3-R6 applies.
